data.name: Hook 2
data.detailed_description:
Hook 2 is a minimal puzzle game about unhooking the hooks. This time with an extra dimension — the puzzles are now in fully rotatable 3D.
Your goal is to remove all the hooks from the board by using various game mechanics that you'll discover along the way.
The game has no text, no ads and no scores. Just pure, simple, relaxing puzzles.

  • Minimalist and relaxing gameplay
  • No ads, no scores, no time limits
  • Dark mode
  • Soothing ambient soundtrack
  • Created by an independent developer

Relax and challenge your mind with Hook 2 — a pure, simple and satisfying puzzle. Are you ready to unhook?
